buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PFA/WESTERN RAILWAY payable at CHURCHGATE, MUMBAI-20 . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PFA/WESTERN RAILWAY payable at CHURCHGATE, MUMBAI-20 . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA/WESTERN RAILWAY payable at CHURCHGATE, MUMBAI-20 A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

(b) For establishing the proof of completed services, bidder shall clearly bifurcate the value of exec uted service in each Financial Year. 2. While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the scre enshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST 7. Vehicle shall not be older than 2024 and KM travelled upto 25,000 km 8. Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proce edings, should not be bankrupt. 9. Type of Service- Both Local & outstation SPECIAL CONDITIONS: a. Deployed vehicles and Drivers shall be solely in control of the officer for whom they have been hired an d Service Provider (Contractor) shall not have the right to deploy the deployed Vehicles or Drivers for anyo ther work at his discretion. b. The Salary to be paid to the Driver shall be according to the latest minimum wage including DA (as appli cable) prescribed by the Chief Labour Commissioner of Central Government or State Government for Skille d labour whichever is higher. c. Service Provider(Contractor) shall submit along-with the running bills, the proof of amount paid to the Go vernment for the Driver(s) deployed against Statutory Employer Contributions viz. PF, ESIC etc. d. The service provider shall be responsible for ensuring compliance with the provisions related to Labour L aw [Central/State] and specially Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Wages Act, PF, ESI Act, Contract Labour [ R&A] Act, 1970 & Minimum wages Act,1948, Workmen Compensation Act, Motor Vehicle Act, Motor Transp ort Workers Act, 1961 etc. and any other relevant acts as applicable at present or in future during the tenu re of the contract and as may be enforced from time to time.
